gloss: plants and animals; flora and fauna

definitions.gloss: plants and animals; flora and fauna; wildlife
definitions.explanation: A collective term covering both animals ({動物|どうぶつ}) and plants ({植物|しょくぶつ}). Used in discussions of biodiversity, ecosystems, nature conservation, and regional wildlife.

examples.japanese: {珍|めずら}しい{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}。
この{島|しま}には{固有|こゆう}の{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This island has many endemic plants and animals.

examples.japanese: {気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えている。
examples.english: Climate change is affecting plants and animals around the world.

examples.japanese: {国立|こくりつ}{公園|こうえん}では、{多様|たよう}な{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}が{保護|ほご}されている。
examples.english: Diverse plants and animals are protected in national parks.

notes:
Compound formed by abbreviating {動物|どうぶつ} ('animal') and {植物|しょくぶつ} ('plant') and joining them under a single {物|ぶつ}. The ordering (animals first, then plants) is fixed — the reverse order is not used.

USAGE:
A convenient umbrella term frequently used in scientific, educational, and conservation contexts where one wants to refer to living things in general without repeating {動物|どうぶつ}と{植物|しょくぶつ}. Common in museum exhibits, field guides, environmental reports, and school science materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {珍|めずら}しい{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: rare plants and animals
- {固有|こゆう}の{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: endemic flora and fauna
- {動植物|どうしょくぶつ}の{保護|ほご}: conservation of plants and animals
- {動植物|どうしょくぶつ}の{生態|せいたい}: the ecology of plants and animals
- {多様|たよう}な{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: diverse flora and fauna
- {絶滅|ぜつめつ}の{危機|きき}にある{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: endangered plants and animals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {動物|どうぶつ}: animal
- {植物|しょくぶつ}: plant
- {生物|せいぶつ}: living things; organisms — broader, includes microbes
- {野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}: wildlife (animals only)
- {生態系|せいたいけい}: ecosystem — the system in which {動植物|どうしょくぶつ} live
